conditions: User needs to provide consent strings or do not track preferences
effects: Configures the privacy preferences of the user, affecting data collection for ads.

conditions: User is not under 13 years of age for COPPA compliance
effects: Enables collection of user data for ad personalization.

conditions: User opts for do not track
effects: User is opted out of data collection for ads.

conditions: Required to display a consent dialog prior to location tracking
effects: Manages whether the SDK can use user location for ad personalization.

conditions: User opts in to location-based ad personalization
effects: Enables location tracking for personalized ads.

conditions: User opts out of location-based ad personalization
effects: Disables location tracking and prevents the collection of location data.
